summary: First-party sources establish a relevant Ukrainian cadastral-map custodian and a Crimea regional public GIS whose indexed layers include cadastral parcels and parcel boundaries. Bounded anonymous requests to the public map viewers timed out; no safe native parcel ID plus full polygon geometry was retrieved, so no sample GeoJSON is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Ukrainian discovery queries, exact text, outcomes and actual result URLs are recorded in city-4034-simferopol.json.
requestOutcomes: GET https://map.land.gov.ua/kadastrova-karta timed out after 15 seconds with no response body. GET https://rgis.rk.gov.ru/map/ember-map/index.html timed out after 15 seconds with no response body; a second bounded curl attempt also timed out after 25 seconds. Indexed first-party viewer content was available through search, but its current JavaScript/configuration and feature service could not be inspected. No POST, login, credential, CAPTCHA, private-token, owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal-field request was made.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Anonymous request timed out after 15 seconds; no HTML, JavaScript, configuration, schema, CRS or parcel response obtained. Official documentation identifies the route and describes public cadastral-map layers.

Official Ukrainian documentation states that the public cadastral map publishes State Land Cadastre information and provides parcel/map-layer navigation; it points to map.land.gov.ua. No live feature response or current API contract.

Search-indexed official viewer exposes parcel-related layer names including cadastral parcels, cadastral quarters, parcels without geometry, and parcel boundaries. Direct anonymous request timed out; no current JavaScript/configuration or feature endpoint obtained.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [44.9501606488552, 34.101582292379] was preserved; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
A viewer timeout and lack of a retrieved feature response are not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
The regional GIS layer list establishes a relevant local/public map route, not verified citywide parcel coverage, open vector delivery, or adapter readiness.
Native parcel identity field, schema, CRS, geometry encoding and composite-key semantics remain unverified.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
